queries_run: RTX GE Aerospace credit rating 2026 downgrade OR upgrade

findings.claim: FY2025 10-K：RTX 與 GE Aerospace 各約占第三方銷售 11%；失去任一重要客戶可能對相關業務造成重大不利影響。
findings.excerpt: In 2025, RTX Corporation and GE Aerospace each represented approximately 11% of the Company’s third-party sales. The loss of any such significant customer could have a material adverse effect on such businesses.

findings.claim: FY2025 10-K：部分最大客戶自有超合金鑄造爐，自行生產翼型精密鑄件，另有多家同業可能競爭。
findings.excerpt: Several of Howmet’s largest customers have captive superalloy furnaces for producing airfoil investment castings for their own use.

customer_concentration_credit.note: 搜尋摘要顯示 GE Aerospace 2026-02 Moody's 由 A3 升 A2、2026-04 S&P 展望轉正；未查到 RTX 評等資料與任何客戶破產/降評事件。無逐字原文，僅列 clues。

clues.claim: GE Aerospace：Moody's 2026-02-02 由 A3 升 A2；S&P 2026-04-16 展望由穩定轉正面，長期 A-。
